meta.name: The Shatkon Channels
meta.notes: Tutorial spine is linear. After The Narrows the map branches.

sectors.name: South Range
sectors.blurb: Live-fire yards on the near side of the channel network. Tight, empty boards.

sectors.name: The Dust Belt
sectors.blurb: A broken wall of rock across the first real transit lane.

sectors.name: The Veil
sectors.blurb: A nebula bank that swallows signatures and spoils clean locks.

sectors.name: The Cut
sectors.blurb: A mined bottleneck. The only passage that looks safe enough to try.

sectors.name: The Narrows
sectors.blurb: Where the channels pinch around a contested beacon.

sectors.name: Beacon Reach
sectors.blurb: The same beacon, now a real objective war rather than a drill.

sectors.name: Practice Yard
sectors.blurb: A short matched field for crews that have finished the spine.

sectors.name: The Outer Dark
sectors.blurb: Open space. The war without walls.

channels.name: Gunnery Drill
channels.briefing: Two tiny ships, one shared thrust pool, an empty yard. Learn to spend command points, split thrust between Dart and Pin, close to laser range, and hunt the flagship rather than the escort.
teaches: selecting ships and spending command points
shared thrust (2 thrust per turn, bank up to 4; 1 hex costs 1)
hex movement and line of fire
laser damage falloff
the flagship win rule (sinking Pin does not end the game)

channels.name: Asteroid Screen
channels.briefing: The first real transit lane is blocked by a broken wall of rock. Peek the centre gap or swing the flanks. You will start just outside exact detection, inside the fuzzy ring.
teaches: asteroids blocking movement and laser sightlines
peeking the gap versus flanking
fuzzy contacts versus exact locks
motion flare (+1 signature after moving 2+ hexes; sitting still is no longer a signature drop)
armour absorbing hits before internal parts

channels.name: Nebula Drift
channels.briefing: A three-segment hull enters the Veil. The cloud hides you and blinds you. Learn the cost of a longer ship, the stealth floor, and when to burn a scan.
teaches: multi-segment footprints and per-segment thrust cost
stealth floor and motion wake versus nebula concealment
active scan (move first, once per ship, +2 flare)

channels.name: Minefield Pass
channels.briefing: The Cut is a narrow corridor already sown with mines. Lasers will not reach from the start line. Plot a launch, trust your point defence, and do not forget your own mine.
teaches: the launch action and seeker locks
own-ship munition pass-through
the 6-tick post-turn flight phase
point defence
mines (stealthy, 4 hits, friendly fire)

channels.name: The Narrows
channels.briefing: The channels pinch here around a live beacon. Take a scout and a heavy flagship, share the thrust pool, and either hold the light or kill their Bulwark. A stealth cloud and a rock-lined firing lane both lead in.
teaches: balancing shared thrust between a cheap scout and a heavy flagship
comms linking so the flagship can fire or lock onto what the scout spots
seeker-drone scouting and remote detonation
recharging shields
contesting and holding a centre beacon without losing the flagship
channels.win: Reach 2 beacon points, or destroy the enemy Bulwark.

channels.name: Beacon Story
channels.briefing: The drill is over. Hold the beacon to 5, or break their flagship. The holder lights up. This is the first story channel, not a tutorial.
channels.win: Reach 5 beacon points, or destroy the enemy flagship. At the turn limit, the higher score wins.

channels.name: Skirmish
channels.briefing: A short matched battle on the default field. Use the full v0.4 catalogue you unlocked on the spine. Good practice before the void.

channels.name: Open Space
channels.briefing: The channels open onto empty dark. A long hunt on the big board, with the full fleet and no tutorial rails. This is the capstone sandbox, not required to finish the campaign.
